blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: You are not immune to propaganda.
exercises.why: Negative adverbs НЕГДЕ, НЕКУДА, НЕОТКУДА, НЕКОГДА are formed by the same principle as negative pronouns НЕКОГО, НЕЧЕГО. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 104.  ·  «The direct object of a verb with negation (with не) is often in the genitive case instead of the accusative.» «Conversely, to say 'There isn't...', 'There aren't...', we use the word нет followed by the genitive case.» — DLI, Lesson 27; Wikibooks, «Genitive case».
exercises.context: Negative adverbs НЕГДЕ, НЕКУДА, НЕОТКУДА, НЕКОГДА are formed by the same principle as negative pronouns НЕКОГО, НЕЧЕГО.
